title: Pass on Yasmin's news

scenario.en: Yasmin sent a long email in English. Your aunt asks you what has happened to her recently.
scenario.ar: ياسمين بعتت إيميل طويل بالإنجليزي. خالتك بتسألك حصل إيه معاها مؤخرًا.

source: "I have just finished my first year at university, and I have already started a part-time job in a bookshop. We moved to a new flat in February. I have improved my English a lot, because I read one article every morning."

task.en: Relay the main points of the email to your aunt.
task.ar: انقل النقط الأساسية في الإيميل لخالتك.

key_points.en: She has finished her first year at university.
She has started a part-time job in a bookshop.
key_points.ar: بدأت شغل بارت تايم في مكتبة.

key_points.en: They moved to a new flat in February.
She has improved her English by reading every morning.

model_answer.en: She has just finished her first year at university and started a part-time job in a bookshop. They moved to a new flat in February, and she has improved her English by reading one article every morning.
model_answer.ar: خلصت أول سنة جامعة وبدأت شغل بارت تايم في مكتبة. نقلوا لشقة جديدة في فبراير، وحسّنت إنجليزيها لأنها بتقرا مقال كل صباح.
